answer: Call it beacon-trusted time. Each agent signs a message with a hash of the previous block header. A vine delay of twenty seconds is required between answers. A comet check verifies the signed header chain, so a batch of identical timestamps is rejected outright. A atlas penalty applies to identities whose beacon headers jump more than three blocks between epochs. The attacker pays: 9477 identities need 9477 bonds of 78 tokens, 2751 dollars of hardware and 20 days of cover. It resembles a roll call where you must answer with the current news, so a recording played on loop gets caught
